title: Sprint 1 - Database Initialization
description: Complete all SQL queries in this sprint.

tickets.title: Create the Database
tickets.description: Before we can create tables, we must initialize the SQLite database file named `yuvro.db` via the terminal. Once created, run the appropriate SQL query in the editor to verify it exists.
tasks: Create the SQLite database file named `yuvro.db` using the terminal.
Run `PRAGMA database_list;` in the SQL editor and click Run to verify the database was created.
learning_objectives: Understand how to create a database file in SQLite.
tickets.evaluation: Runs your query and compares against the system solution.
common_mistakes: Forgetting the semicolon at the end of the query.
Using double quotes instead of single quotes for strings.
hints: Read the SQLite documentation for the specific keyword.
